name: The Well of Three Measures
region_detail: A rocky plain along the northern approaches to the Qasari oasis settlements.
site_type: well | Inhabited locations | Communal well, watering station, and disputed water concession.
history: Qasari families constructed a stone-lined well beside a customary caravan route. Three marked basins distinguish water allotted to households, livestock, and passing travelers. Generations of waterkeepers have recorded withdrawals and maintained the associated channels under communal agreements.
current_state: Serath Qasir has sold access to the well to Cadorian settlers without the authorization of the elders. Several families have established shelters and begun cultivating nearby ground in reliance upon the arrangement. Qasari waterkeepers continue to distribute water according to customary rights while the validity of the transaction remains disputed.
inhabitants: Qasari waterkeepers and their households; Cadorian homesteaders; passing caravans and Dune Rider patrols.
danger_level: Low ordinarily; moderate if either party attempts to enforce exclusive access.
points_of_interest:
Stone-lined well; three marked basins; distribution channels; waterkeepers’ ledger; newly established homesteads; sheltered livestock enclosure.

Unresolved elements: The precise provisions of the disputed deeds; Whether the well draws upon the affected ancient watercourse; Whether the settlers can remain under a revised arrangement.
discovery: A rocky plain along the northern approaches to the Qasari oasis settlements. Caravan guides know the well. Serath Qasir, Elder Nahira, and settlers holding the disputed deeds can identify its location.
related_records:
Adventure Hook: The Price of Water — Direct. The well is the subject of the unauthorized transaction.
Job: J-RV-006 — Double-Sold Water! — Potential. Two homestead families may present conflicting deeds to the well.
Faction Plot: P-009 — The Wells of the Ancients — Potential. Declining regional water supplies may intensify the dispute; the well is not necessarily affected initially.

Notable individuals and factions: Nahira sa-Qesh (N-048) — seeks recognition of Qasari territorial and water rights; Serath Qasir (N-050) — responsible for the disputed sale; Azhar Tarek (N-049) — may dispatch Dune Riders to protect the well; Orrick Vane (N-118) — potential source of information concerning Cadorian deeds; Local waterkeepers and Cadorian homesteaders.
